assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final production iOS app icon for Teto, a dance community app.
Create one original, beautifully resolved, minimal brand symbol: an abstract joyful dancer whose flowing body and outstretched arms subtly form a lowercase t. The head is a separate small pale lime circle offset above the shoulder. A single bold warm ivory continuous sculptural ribbon forms the broad rising arms, leaning torso and a sweeping bent leg / foot, with the other leg suggested by an elegant negative-space split. It must feel like a dancer caught in a groove, relaxed, confident and social, not a running person, yoga pose, generic accessibility person, musical note or ordinary typed letter. Favor a memorable simple silhouette over anatomical detail. Rounded terminals, optically balanced broad curves, distinctive asymmetry and open negative space. Design-quality flat vector-like finish.
Color palette: perfectly uniform evergreen #126B58 background covering the entire square to all four edges; ivory #FAFBF7 main symbol; small pale lime #DDF4A6 head accent. Only these three colors, with natural edge antialiasing.
Composition: square 1024x1024; one centered mark with approximately 19 percent clear space on each side, symbol about 62 percent canvas width and 66 percent height. Keep every element within the central safe area. Bold enough to read at 40 pixels.
Constraints: full-bleed opaque square, no pre-rounded outer corners, no border, no text, no wordmark, no letters apart from the abstract implied t, no watermark, no gradients, no shadow, no texture, no 3D, no shine, no extra orbit, no star, no heart, no speech bubble, no device, no sheet of alternatives. Deliver only the icon artwork.

usage: Original AI-generated brand artwork for Teto. No third-party asset or font was imported. This record does not assert trademark clearance.
validation: Static source/resource checks and direct inspection of generated images only. No app build, simulator, tests or SwiftUI Preview.
